about: Map files whose top-down picture (icons/maps/map_<ver>.webp, <ver> = the first patch that shipped the file) we rendered ourselves; every other picture is still a borrowed render. sfm = Source Filmmaker, scripts/gen/stitch_sfm.py (docs/terrain.md); sfm-7.40c = rendered on the 7.40c build of the game (the current engine breaks older maps' water). 7.39's two pink templar gates are mended from 7.39b (scripts/gen/mend_map.py). The Terrain page's credit line names whatever is still borrowed.
